chunks: And it has indeed been narrated:
"There is no harm if the left hand is incapacitated."

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or transmitted
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is there any harm if the left hand is incapacitated in the etiquette of relieving oneself?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal concession regarding a case in which the left hand is incapacitated. It indicates that the usual etiquette or practice is excused when physical inability is present.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "There is no harm if the left hand is incapacitated (or missing)."
